description: The file declares functions related to extracting images and archive contents from archive files, as well as extracting archives into memory and listing archive contents within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: ExtractImages
methods.description: Extracts multiple images from an archive file to a target directory, optionally keeping the archive.

methods.name: ExtractImage
methods.description: Extracts a single image from an archive file to a target directory, with an optional parameter to keep the archive.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveContents
methods.description: Lists contents of an archive file into a target directory, with an option to keep the archive.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveToMemory
methods.description: Extracts the entire archive into memory as a string.

methods.name: ArchiveContents
methods.description: Returns a list of contents within the archive file.
